messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Albuterol is a bronchodilator.
Albuterol relaxes muscles in the airways.
Albuterol increases air flow to the lungs.
Albuterol inhalation is used to treat or prevent bronchospasm.
Bronchospasm is the narrowing of the airways in the lungs.
Albuterol inhalation is used in people with asthma.
Albuterol inhalation is used in people with certain types of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD).
Albuterol is also used to prevent exercise-induced bronchospasm.
Albuterol inhalation is for use in adults and children who are at least 2 years old.
Always follow your doctor's directions when giving albuterol to a child.
Triplet: ["Albuterol Inhalation", "used to prevent", "exercise-induced bronchospasm"]

The relation 'used to prevent' in the triplet is defined as 'The subject drug is used to prevent or reduce the likelihood of the medical condition or event specified by the object entity.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'reduces risk of': The subject drug is used to prevent or lower the risk of the medical event or condition specified by the object entity.
B. 'treats': The subject drug is used to treat or manage the disease or medical condition specified by the object entity.
C. 'may be used for': The subject drug may be used for the purpose or condition specified by the object entity.
D. 'has warning': The subject drug carries a safety warning or precaution about the risk or situation specified by the object entity.
E. 'increases risk of': Taking the subject drug may raise the patient's likelihood of experiencing the condition or event specified by the object entity.
F. None of the above.
